headline: New Flurry of Strongpoint Fighting Sweeps Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Weathered Expanse has taken the lead in churning strongpoint control, recording ten ownership events in the two hours to 03:10 and thirty-nine in the past day. Frostmarch and Crow's Nest supplied most of that activity. Stlican Shelf stayed hot with five events in that same closing window and thirty-four for the day, centered on Vulpine Watch and Pale House. Fisherman's Row, the busiest front in the last report, cooled to two events in the final two hours but still logged thirty-nine over the full day, chiefly at Eidolo and Black Well. Farranac Coast also posted two fresh events. Godcrofts and Mooring County have gone quiet after their earlier activity; Stonecradle has produced no events in six hours as midday's action faded, and LinnMercy managed only two. Daily casualties remain enormous at Weathered Expanse and Stonecradle, while Stlican Shelf also reports heavy losses. Neither faction has yet claimed the required thirty-four victory towns.
